name: enginuity
description: Enginuity: a robot cell simulator and offline programming studio with a robolink-compatible API, an MCP server and a Copilot agent

scripts.test:py: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s python/tests -v && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s python/enginuity/tests -v
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/rc_core/Cargo.toml && cp crates/rc_core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rc_core.wasm public/wasm/rc_core.wasm
scripts.build:cad: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/rc_cad/Cargo.toml && cp crates/rc_cad/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/rc_cad.wasm public/wasm/rc_cad.wasm
scripts.test:all: npm run test:rust && npm run test:py && npm test
